author: Forbes
description:
In this thought-provoking conversation, Bill Cummings joins Luisa Kroll to discuss the principles, motivations, and impact of strategic philanthropy.
Bill Cummings shares why he and his wife made the decision decades ago to give away their entire fortune and how joining the The Giving Pledge aligned with values they had long embraced. He explains how the initiative has helped normalize large-scale charitable giving and encouraged other wealthy individuals to commit to philanthropy.

The discussion also provides an inside look at the unique grantmaking model of the Cummings Foundation. Rather than relying solely on staff, the foundation empowers nearly 180 community volunteers—including nurses, firefighters, educators, and other local leaders—to evaluate hundreds of nonprofit applications through a rigorous four-stage review process.

description:
What does it take to build an extraordinary life in America as an immigrant woman?

In this inspiring conversation, Pulitzer Prize-winning playwright Martyna Majok and Anastasia Beverly Hills Founder & CEO Anastasia Soare join Forbes Senior Editor Alex Knapp to discuss their remarkable journeys from arriving in the United States with limited resources to achieving extraordinary success.

The discussion explores the challenges of adapting to a new country, overcoming financial hardship, navigating language barriers, and finding resilience in the face of adversity. Majok reflects on how her experiences as a Polish immigrant shaped her work as a storyteller, while Soare shares how she identified an overlooked opportunity in the beauty industry and built a global billion-dollar brand.

author: Forbes
description:
From humble beginnings as the youngest of 13 children in a sharecropper family to becoming one of America's most influential energy entrepreneurs, Harold Hamm shares the remarkable story behind his rise to success.

In this fireside chat, Hamm reflects on growing up in rural Oklahoma, the lessons learned from poverty, and the determination that fueled his journey into the oil and gas industry. He discusses how hard work, perseverance, and mentorship helped him overcome challenges, including years of setbacks early in his career.

Hamm recounts his pioneering role in horizontal drilling technology, a breakthrough that helped transform U.S. energy production and contributed to America's emergence as a global energy leader. Along the way, he offers insights on leadership, resilience, entrepreneurship, and the importance of creating opportunities through education.
